noise_assumptions.notes: The quoted gate and readout rates match the fixed QFF2026-v2 model for transparent comparison. These descriptive assumptions do not configure the benchmark; it imports the organizer noise model unchanged. Task B uses gate noise only and does not measure, so readout error is not applied.

design_rationale: This six-qubit custom topology preserves the Phase 1 K4 computational core on qubits 0-3 and its two connected ancillae. Bidirectional CX links on the K4 support every pair in a four-qubit all-to-all ZZ feature map without routing SWAPs, while the same core contains the three logical QFT-3 qubits. The rx/ry/rz/cx basis is universal for these circuits and each gate is covered by the QFF2026-v2 noise model. The two ancillae increase connectivity options but also add physical resources that the four-qubit kernel does not need; the benchmark does not establish classifier accuracy or optimality.
